cost_schedule_control.what: Owning a programme's budget and schedule: tracking spend and progress against the baseline and correcting course.

earned_value_mgmt.what: Measuring programme progress with earned value (EVM/EVMS), control accounts and an integrated master schedule, as defence and government contracts require.

program_governance_reviews.what: Setting up how programmes are run and reviewed: PMO standards, steering committees, stage gates and programme reviews with leadership or the customer.

resource_planning.what: Working out the people and capacity a programme needs, when, and resolving conflicts across projects.
